title: Drawing with the Brush
content: You don't need to do a detailed drawing as long as your measurements are right. (Link to video)Here's the sequence, drawing with the brush:1. Warm-primed canvas2. Careful measurements with brush.3. Big areas blocked in.4. Subdivide small forms.5. Details and accents.----I invite you to check out my channels and follow or subscribe if you like what you see:JamesGurneyArt on InstagramGurneyJourney YouTube ChannelMy public Facebook pageJames Gurney on TwitterGurneyJourney on Pinterest
